item.title: The Seven Good Years: A Memoir
item.description:
The Seven Good Years: A Memoir by Etgar Keret

Summary

“The Seven Good Years: A Memoir” by Etgar Keret is an exploration of the author’s life experiences during a period bracketed by his son’s birth and his father’s death. These years, set in Israel, are filled with poignant moments that encompass a range of emotional highs and lows. The book combines humor and melancholy as Keret reflects on being a father, son, and citizen, amid the complex backdrop of the socio-political climate in Israel. The memoir is a collection of personal anecdotes and observations, each rich with Keret’s signature wit and sense of the absurd, providing a window into his world and thought processes during this significant time frame.
